sub_questions: Is a signed scoping agreement/rules of engagement in place authorizing the target range?
Are testing boundaries and exclusions documented?
VAPT-1.remediation_guidance: Obtain a signed scoping agreement and rules-of-engagement document authorizing the tested target range before testing begins.

sub_questions: Are OSINT/reconnaissance results documented (domain footprinting, asset discovery)?
VAPT-2.remediation_guidance: Perform and document OSINT/reconnaissance covering domain footprinting and asset discovery.

sub_questions: Is a network vulnerability scanning report available (e.g. Nessus, Qualys, OpenVAS)?
Does it list open ports and identified CVEs?
VAPT-3.remediation_guidance: Perform and retain a network vulnerability scan report identifying open ports and CVEs.

sub_questions: Is a web application penetration test report available mapping findings to OWASP Top 10 categories?
VAPT-4.remediation_guidance: Perform web application penetration testing and map findings to OWASP Top 10 categories.

sub_questions: Is an internal network penetration test report available?
Are Active Directory exploit/pivot logs documented?
VAPT-5.remediation_guidance: Perform internal network penetration testing including AD exploitation/pivoting attempts, and document results.

sub_questions: Is an external penetration test report available covering internet-facing edge systems?
VAPT-6.remediation_guidance: Perform and document external penetration testing of internet-facing/edge systems.

sub_questions: Are privilege escalation testing logs/proofs (screenshots, shell captures) available?
VAPT-7.remediation_guidance: Perform privilege escalation testing and retain proof (logs, screenshots) of findings.

sub_questions: Was a social engineering/phishing simulation conducted?
Are campaign results and click-rate statistics documented?
VAPT-8.remediation_guidance: Conduct a phishing/social engineering simulation and document campaign results and click rates.

sub_questions: Was wireless security testing performed?
Are rogue access point findings and configuration reviews documented?
VAPT-9.remediation_guidance: Perform wireless security testing including rogue AP detection and configuration review.

sub_questions: Was API security testing performed?
Are endpoint authorization (e.g. JWT) findings documented?
VAPT-10.remediation_guidance: Perform API security testing covering endpoint access control and authorization mechanisms.

sub_questions: Is a vulnerability remediation tracker maintained?
Are patch confirmation records retained for closed findings?
VAPT-11.remediation_guidance: Maintain a remediation tracker and retain patch confirmation evidence for closed findings.

sub_questions: Is patch compliance verified (e.g. WSUS reports, patch history)?
VAPT-12.remediation_guidance: Verify and document patch compliance via patch management tooling reports.

sub_questions: Is a firewall configuration baseline documented?
Are network segmentation (VLAN) maps available?
VAPT-13.remediation_guidance: Document firewall configuration baselines and network segmentation maps, and review periodically.

sub_questions: Are systems benchmarked against a secure configuration baseline (e.g. CIS benchmarks)?
VAPT-14.remediation_guidance: Benchmark and harden systems against a recognized secure configuration baseline (e.g. CIS).

sub_questions: Is a final signed VAPT report available with executive summary and severity statistics?
VAPT-15.remediation_guidance: Produce and obtain sign-off on a final VAPT report including executive summary and severity trend statistics.
